title: Your mind can lie to you with a straight face.
paragraphs: Your mind can lie to you with a straight face.

Fear sounds like wisdom.
Shame sounds like humility.
Temptation sounds like relief.
And if you don’t test those voices, you will start calling bondage “normal.”
Jesus prayed, “Sanctify them by the truth; your word is truth.” — John 17:17

That means holiness does not begin with better vibes.
It begins with surrendered thoughts.
Not every thought deserves a seat at the table.
Not every feeling deserves the final word.

But here’s what we miss:
The battle for purity, peace, and obedience is often won or lost in the mind before it ever shows up in public.
The enemy distorts.
The flesh negotiates.
But the Word of God cuts through the fog.

So when your mind says, “You’re too far gone,” truth says, there is no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.
When your mind says, “Follow your heart,” truth says, guard it.
When your mind says, “You need this sin,” truth says, Christ is enough.

Beloved, aligning your thoughts with truth is not pretending the struggle is not real.
It is choosing a higher voice.
A holier voice.
The voice of the Shepherd over the noise of the soul.
And that’s where grace walks in.

Jesus does not just expose lies.
He renews minds.
He breaks strongholds.
He teaches us to think in the light.

So today, do not just ask, “What am I feeling?”
Ask, “What has God said?”
Because freedom begins when your thoughts bow to truth.
